title: Public Health – Drainage & Domestic Water
activity: Soil, waste, rainwater and domestic water – install, test and access
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Pipework installed to the PBS construction drawing, coordinated with other services?
Brackets within typical centres (plastic waste 0.5 m, soil 1.0 m horizontal), no sagging?

guide.title: Pipe support centres – typical max
guide.note: Typical industry values – the manufacturer's / PBS drawing figure governs. Anything sagging fails regardless.
guide.src: BS EN 806 / BS 8000-15 typical tables; CLM tested details (400 mm)

questions.q: Drainage falling the right way with no back-falls; joints fully home?
Open ends capped/taped to keep debris out?
Fire sleeves/collars fitted where pipes pass through fire walls and floors?
Ask the fitter: Has it been air/water tested, and where are the rodding and access points? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Domestic water pressure tested (1.5× working pressure)?
Pipe IDs and flow direction labelled; rodding/access points accessible?
Insulation complete on cold and hot pipes, no gaps at fittings?

notOk.t: No access to drain cocks / valves; labels missing
Rodding eyes level instead of falling to the stack
AV pads missing on drainage pipework
Hot box penetrations not fire sealed
